headline: 307 distinct published feeders, best 7.5 MW; totals describe only the top 4000 feed rows by capacity (complete at or above 1.82 MW), so the median is not the area's median

load.means: LOAD-serving capacity — what a NEW DATA-CENTER LOAD can draw. This is the type that answers "can I site N MW here".

sample.truncation_note: The feed returns rows capacity-DESC and capped this read at 4000 rows, so it is COMPLETE at or above 1.82 MW and partial below it. max_mw is exact; median_mw describes only the returned head, not the whole territory. Narrow the radius or set min_mw at/above the floor for a complete answer. capacity_floor_mw is the floor of the raw read, before the min_mw and capacity_type filters; filtered_set_complete says whether the set you asked for is complete.
sample.basis: Published rows are GIS vertices of feeder lines; this read folded 4000 rows into 307 distinct records (13.0x). Every capacity statistic here is computed over DISTINCT records, never raw rows.
